video_title: The Next Chapter | Inside Norman Powell's Offseason & Signing with the Chicago Bulls

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his role and impact with the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: I want to give everything to the team, to the organization, to the fans, to etch my name
quotes.quote: How do I feel I can help this team both on and off the court? I want to give everything to the team, to the organization, to the fans, to etch my name in Bulls history. I'm somebody that grinds, somebody that works, somebody that's mentally tough, not going to shy away from the big moments or adversity.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on maintaining his career goals in his 11th year
quotes.excerpt: I always have big childhood goals that I still have and I still want to accomplish
quotes.quote: The biggest part is staying focused and continuing to maintain the big goals that I've set out for myself every single year. I always have big childhood goals that I still have and I still want to accomplish, even though I'm in my 11th year.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on overcoming doubt and proving his place in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: They always have tried to put me in a box or limit me or tell me where
quotes.quote: They always have tried to put me in a box or limit me or tell me where I'm supposed to be or that I don't belong in the NBA since coming into the league as a second-round pick. I know what vision and how I saw myself and I held on to that and I kept working, kept working, kept working, kept it head down and just waited for my opportunity.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on achieving his goal of becoming an NBA All-Star
quotes.excerpt: Being 33 and making my first All-Star, it's very funny because I don't feel 33
quotes.quote: Being 33 and making my first All-Star, it's very funny because I don't feel 33. It was one of the personal goals that I had set out for myself when I was a little kid. I finally accomplished it, even though it's in my 11th year, it's still a great feat.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his surprise at joining the Bulls in free agency
quotes.excerpt: It was a team that I wasn't expecting to be a part of during free agency
quotes.quote: It was a team that I wasn't expecting to be a part of during free agency. When Thiago was giving me a list of names and then they got added into the mix, part of like the third or fourth phone call, I was shocked, I was surprised just because of the youth that they have on the team and I felt like they were going into like a younger rebuild mode.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on the surreal experience of wearing a Bulls jersey
quotes.excerpt: It reminds me of when I was a kid watching Michael Jordan to the max
quotes.quote: It was crazy. I just kept saying that it reminds me of when I was a kid watching Michael Jordan to the max. I used to watch that on repeat growing up. I've always wanted to play for the Bulls and put a jersey on to follow Michael Jordan's footsteps. Another surreal moment for me in my career, putting that jersey on and having the Bulls going across my chest.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his expectations for the young Bulls roster
quotes.excerpt: I think we have a group where we're already being written off just because we're young
quotes.quote: I think we have a group where we're already being written off just because we're young, but I think we have the potential and the ability to surprise some teams and some people this year. I'm definitely going to help lead the young guys, help mentor them, help build a winning mentality and culture.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on the importance of work ethic over draft position
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't matter where you're drafted, all that matters is your dedication and your belief in yourself
quotes.quote: The kid got picked 46 in the draft, 46 is special because that's when I was drafted. I think the biggest thing that I want them to take from my career is that it doesn't matter where you're drafted, all that matters is your dedication and your belief in yourself and your ability. You have to go out and show everybody that they made a mistake and that you're here to stay.
